title: Report product count by product type

expectedResponse.message: No product/report endpoint is defined in the supplied Swagger; this SQL case remains a database-only validation.

sqlValidation:
SELECT productType, COUNT(*) AS productCount
FROM dbo.Products
GROUP BY productType
ORDER BY productCount DESC;
sqlExpectedResult: Counts accurately represent products in each productType.
dbReconciliation: TC-SQL-043: No direct Swagger endpoint is available; retain the SQL result as the authoritative database validation and do not infer an API contract. Expected SQL outcome: Counts accurately represent products in each productType.
